def apply_coords(self, coords: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Apply crop transform on coordinates.

    Args:
        coords (ndarray): floating point array of shape Nx2. Each row is
            (x, y).
    Returns:
        ndarray: cropped coordinates.
    """
    coords[:, 0] -= self.x0
    coords[:, 1] -= self.y0
    return coords
